title: Explicit single and shift calculation for finite realization
statement: For an arbitrary functor F into the derived internal module category and a supplied endpoint square F(beta) followed by t = a.hom followed by alpha, realizing that square gives the displayed composite of the exact single and shift comparison maps. The derived representative of finiteRealizedClass(alpha) appears on the left; the realized image of beta and target endpoint appear on the right.

source.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension

proof.text: Use finiteRealizedClass_hom to expose the representative. Cancel the ordinary supported-source comparison with its inverse, map the supplied square through the exact derived functor, and reassociate the remaining single and shift maps.

proof_origin.place: paragraph (1), finite cyclic reduction followed by finite coefficient extension
proof_origin.note: Separate the supported-constant and positive-root endpoint calculations from naturality of an arbitrary diagonal arrow.

theorem finiteRealization_compositionCore
    {R : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}}
    [MonObj R] [IsCommMonObj R] {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (Y : Scheme.{u})
    {L : ∀ X : Scheme.{u}, Modules R X}
    (eW : FiniteRealization R A (diagonalSurface Y))
    (line : eW.F.obj (L (diagonalSurface Y)) ≅ geoCartierLine A N hA (diagonalSurface Y))
    (s : eW.F.obj (source R Y) ≅
      (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (diagonalImmersion Y)).obj
        (geoCartierConstant A (ProjectiveLine Y)))
    {B : Type*} [Category B] (F : B ⥤ DerivedCategory (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)))
    {S T : B}
    (a : F.obj S ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (source R Y))
    (t : F.obj T ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
      (L (diagonalSurface Y)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (β : S ⟶ T)
    (α : (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Modules R (diagonalSurface Y)) 0).obj
      (source R Y) ⟶ ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
        (L (diagonalSurface Y)))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (h : F.map β ≫ t = a.hom ≫ α) :
    (eW.F.mapDerivedCategory.mapIso a ≪≫
      (eW.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso s).hom ≫
        (finiteRealizedClass (L := L) N hA Y eW line s α).hom =
      (F ⋙ eW.F.mapDerivedCategory).map β ≫
        (eW.F.mapDerivedCategory.map t ≫
          (eW.F.mapDerivedCategory.commShiftIso (2 : ℤ)).hom.app _ ≫
          ((eW.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).hom.app _ ≫
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).map line.hom)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧')
